content: Iesu Sibo Sinat Pilate Nanai Itawar

Fomenei fomenei priest aiwabis, sabu kawian, Baifafaro an baibebeotis, a Jew Babadis Rurubinis on engon tutufin baiyagiginai nan siruayo asi bainonot on sidudurai. Osi Iesu iman sifatumen ato sibonanawai sinai Pilate imanai siyagai.
Pilate on Iesu itetemai iyau, “Om min Jew yangan asi Aiwab i?” Iesu iyafotai iyau, “Om dura ato u’yau on nanaba.”
Priest aiwabis on bobo sigaraba auris on Iesu siubarai,
on mes Pilate on itetemai men iyau, “Om min arimon dura uniyafoteu i? Osi Om sebiubarem an dura min etatam!”
Iesu men igogoi dura tani itau men ato on aurin on Pilate iduduran wat.
Pilate on Iesu Itetemai Itirabobai aurin
Kwanda fufur Baisobon an Forag an ra Pilate on bobo nanaba ifofour sabu on aurin sibifefeyan ato orot tani fafatum goai imama on iboseirai i’gat.
On an werai sabu fonaseirotis fani on gawan aurin on fetag fetag sigagam orot siyasubun, on mes osi on fafatum goai siwanis simama, on orot tani min Barabbas.
Sabu kuayo gagamin siruayo mom ato sibosuruf Pilate sibifefeyanai an bobo mamaba ainau ifofour on nanaba asi gogoi on itafour weines mes,
on itetemis iyau, “Omi wogogoi yau Jew yangan asi Aiwab an yatetai ingat weinem?”
Pilate isagob tiwag priest aiwabis on Iesu siboboarai on mes osi Iesu sibo on imanai siyagai.
Baise priest aiwabis on sabu kuayo gagamin auris on dura sikitabirai yas sibogagaien ato sifefeyan Pilate aurin on Barabbas ityatetai itgat weines.
Pilate on sabu kuayo auris dura ikakafun men iyau, “Omi ami gogoi aifan aurim anafour atonio orot woyoyorai Jew yangan asi Aiwab i?”
Osi engon tutufin siyoku men siyau, “Nabai ekubarai!”
Pilate itetemis iyau, “Baise On Orot on abi bobo komasin ifour?” Osi engon tutufin aumiet bag siyoku siyau, “Nabai ekubarai!”
Pilate igogoi sabu itiyasisires, on mes Barabbas iyatetai igat weines. Namon Pilate on wou yangan iyawures Iesu siyaswabirai weie osi imasi iyagai nabai sitkubarai mes.
Wou Yangan Iesu Sikoboai
Wou yangan Iesu sibo sirui Rome orot gagamin an goa amonai ato wou yangan fani ba siyores nan siruayo.
Osi beber mururin sibo Iesu siyotai ato wengar aisikis fafames mat siboen nigir siyamai uninai siyein.
Namon osi sibosuruf Iesu sibikakaiwai si’yau, “Jew yangan asi Aiwab, wera roke mama wantoanin!”
Osi siwa sibo Iesu uninai sirab, sikantuturai, osi On aurin sindas sirorouin, ato sikwakwafirai.
Osi sikoboai isawar weie beber mururin siboseir men ato Toun an beber on siyotai men. Namon osi Iesu sibonanawai sigat nabai sitkubarai mes.
Iesu Nabai Sikubarai

Osi si’nan eta nenenai ato orot wabin Simon on mat sinofoten, on tafanam tani emon i’nat au mafam gagamin, ato wou yangan on orot sibo sirukokouai siyawur Iesu an nab iyabar. (Simon on Cyrene mafam gagamin emon ato on min Alexander a Rufus rus tamas.)
Osi Iesu sibonanawai sinai tafanam wabin seyoyorai Golgotha on nan sigat, on tafanam an yabin min, “Tekwakwan an efan.”
Osi nan sifourtobon sareu wine on fio riribin bag on mat sisutatabir sititai ittoman mes, baise Iesu on men fofonin ittoman.
Namon osi Iesu nabai sikubarai ato an beber sibo tous sanasi siraram, ato osi asi barom siyo nan sitsagob wou orot menan on beber itboai.
Fomenei wera auyotoat sasagis baibatin nanaba on osi Iesu nabai sikubarai.
On an ubar dura on wengar sibo nan sigayam unin tefanai nan wengarai sidudun siyau, “Jew yangan asi Aiwab.”
Mat osi orot yakeotis ruam siboes Iesu mat nabai sikubares, orot tani on an asumaiauai a orot tani on an asugagafai.
(On etaiai on God an dura sigagayam on inat idura bag, God an dura buk amonai sigayam siyau, “On sabu yakeotis mat simakiai.’)
Sabu nan si’nan si’nat on unis siyuyuwe ato Iesu sibikoboai: Osi si’yau, “Aha! Om uyau tafaror goa utgoros ato ra baitonin amonai utyon men!”
Osi si’yau, “Om ari nab emon esur ato Toum eiyawasim tait.”
On eta kaitamomai priest aiwabis a Baifafaro an baibebeotis osi mat Iesu sikoboai, ato tous wat auris siyau bonen, “On tuturan fani ibiyawasis, baise On Toun on men fofonin iniyawasai on!
Ot Keriso tanitai, Israel yangan asi Aiwab, On ari bag nab emon esur ato ot On tanitutumai!” Ato orot ruam Iesu mat nabai sikukubares on osi mat simisir Iesu sigigimai.
Iesu Irabob
Wera aiyet nanaba on tafanam engon tutufin iwouman, inai wera ton nanaba isawar.
Ibirabirabi wera ton nanaba Iesu on aumiet bag iyor iyau, “Eloi, Eloi, lema Sabachthani?” on an yabin min, “Au God, au God, Om aibo mes uikirireu?”
Sabu fani nan sitatawar on sitatamai ato siyau, “Wotatam, On Elijah aurin eyoyor!”

Orot tani beber samisamin ibo ramo amonai sareu wine riribin ikutub ato siwa kanfounai iyein. Namon on siwa iyotogai Iesu giburunai iyein ato iyau, “Womousin! Tanitai Elijah on enat Iesu nab emon inboai inyeirai!”
Iesu aumiet iwaf namon irabob.
Beber nan tafaror goa amonai iroror on isafef ruam simatar tefanai isur inai babanai igat.
Wou yangan asi bainetewar orot nan nab nanai itatawar on Iesu it mamaba irabob. On iyau, “Atonio Orot on dura bag God Natun!”
Jever fani on nan, nanenei sitawar siruruai. Osi sanasi on Mary Magdalene, Mary, James kafakakai a Joseph rus ayos a Salome.
Osi on nan Galilee emon Iesu sigibubunuai sinat ato Iesu an gogoi on sibaisin. Jever fani sigaraba on nan, osi on Iesu mat sinat au Jerusalem.
Iesu Sigarobai

Ibirabirabi ato Joseph on an mafam gagamin on Arimathea, on emon inat. On orot on Jew Babadis Rurubinis an kuayo orot tani ato on orot on God an Baiaiwab enat aurin on imomousin. Botitiwag an ra (on ra itatom on Sabat), on mes Joseph on totor wat irui Pilate nanai itawar ato Iesu usin boin aurin on ifefeyanai,
Iesu irabob nono duran Pilate itatam on men sunub iduduran on. On mes wou yangan asi bainetewar orot iyor ato itetemai dura bag Iesu on men ari irabob nono.
Wou yangan asi bainetewar orot an dudur on Pilate itatam isawar ato on Joseph ibasitai Iesu usin itboai mes.

Joseph beber neneyan kakakaiin obin itobon ato usin ibo iyeirai, beberai ikiman ato rasi dogu amonai iwan. Ato rasi agim wawanin on ainau isar ibotitiwag i’yen nono. Namon on agim gagamin ifiruruai dogu awan iyafotai.
Mary Magdalene a Mary, Joseph ayon osi matasi sit Iesu usin nan siyein.
